# Data

## prep
```{r setup}
#| include: false
library("dplyr") # our favorite data wrangling toolbox
library("dbplyr") # dplyr + databases
library("arrow") # writing parquet files
library("ggplot2") # a visualization toolbox
library("gstat") # geospatial statistics
library("sdmTMB") # species distribution models Template Model Builder
library("mapview") # viewing maps


source("./watina_migration.R")

# option to work offline; requires previous data download
work_offline <- TRUE

# connect watina 
if (!work_offline && !exists("watina_dwh")) {
  watina_dwh <- connect_watina()
}

# create a data folder (if not present)
dir.create("./data", showWarnings = FALSE)

# options(browser = "librewolf") # a rather personal thing

# the user may choose to reload raw data
force_database_download <- FALSE

if ("" == getOption("browser")) options(browser = "librewolf")

```


```{r data-settings}

extent <- 1024 # m
n_bins <- 128

```


## query
```{r raw-data-query-xg3}


query_xg3 <- function (){
  tbl(watina_dwh, "factBRPeilMetingJaar") %>%
    filter(IsHydroJaar == 1) %>% 
    select(
      MeetpuntWID,
      Jaar,
      HGmTAWValue,
      LGmTAWValue,
      VGmTAWValue
    ) %>%
    filter_at(
      vars(HGmTAWValue, LGmTAWValue),
      all_vars(!is.na(.))
    ) %>% 
    left_join(
      tbl(watina_dwh, "dimMeetpunt"),
      by = join_by(MeetpuntWID == MeetpuntWID),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(MeetpuntStatusCode == "VLD") %>%
    select(
      MeetpuntWID,
      # FilterLengte,
      # MeetpuntStatusCode,
      MeetpuntCode,
      Jaar,
      MeetpuntXCoordinaat,
      MeetpuntYCoordinaat,
      HGmTAWValue,
      LGmTAWValue,
    ) %>%
    rename(
      idx = MeetpuntWID,
      code = MeetpuntCode,
      hyear = Jaar,
      x = MeetpuntXCoordinaat,
      y = MeetpuntYCoordinaat,
      hw = HGmTAWValue,
      lw = LGmTAWValue
    ) %>%
   filter_at(
    vars(code, hyear, hw, lw),
    all_vars(!is.na(.))
  )

}

```


```{r query-data}
data_export_file <- "data/xg3_data_raw.parquet"
reload <- force_database_download || !file.exists(data_export_file)

if ((!work_offline) && reload_gstat) {
  data <- query_xg3() %>%
    # rename(z = fdepth, ref = ref_taw) %>%
    select(idx, code, hyear, x, y, hw, lw) %>% 
    filter_at(
      vars(x, y, hw, lw),
      all_vars(!is.na(.))
    ) %>% 
    collect %>%
    mutate(
      region = substring(code, first = 1, last = 3)
    ) %>%
    filter(region != "VBS") # remove 
  write_parquet(data, sink = data_export_file)
} else {
  data <- read_parquet(data_export_file)
}

glimpse(data)
```


Data de-trending:


```{r}
data <- data %>% 
  mutate(
    hwd2 = lm(hw ~ x + y, data)$residual,
    lwd2 = lm(lw ~ x + y, data)$residual
  )
```


## cluster and map

Clustering fails: there are memory issues and it fails in `hclust` saying `size cannot be NA or exceed 65536.` :(


```{r cluster-function}
cluster_locs <- function (
    input,
    xvar = "x",
    yvar = "y",
    max_dist = 1,
    output_var = "cluster_id"
  ) {
  coords <- input[, c(xvar, yvar)]
  cluster_data <- coords %>%
    dist %>%
    fastcluster::hclust(method = "complete") %>%
    stats::cutree(h = max_dist) %>%
    tibble::enframe(name = NULL, value = output_var) %>%
    bind_cols(input, .)
}
```

- https://spatialanalysis.github.io/workshop-notes/spatial-clustering.html
- https://github.com/jokergoo/ComplexHeatmap/issues/1021 -> https://github.com/cran/fastcluster
- 


Evaluate ideal cluster size:
```{r evaluate-cluster-distance}
#| eval: false

locs <- data %>% 
  distinct(x, y)

dists <- c()
cluster_count <- c()

for (dist in seq(10, 8000, length.out = 800)) {
  dists <- c(dists, dist)
  locs_clustered <- cluster_locs(
    input = locs,
    max_dist = dist, # m 
    output_var = "cluster",
    xvar = "x",
    yvar = "y"
  ) 

  order <- locs_clustered %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>% 
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(count)) %>%
    pull(cluster)
  cluster_count <- c(cluster_count, length(order))

  
  # head(locs)

  g <- locs_clustered %>%

    mutate(

        )
      )
    ) %>% 
    # group_by(region, code, cluster) %>%

    ggplot(aes(x = cluster_sorted)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = max(data2$cluster), color = "black", fill = "lightgrey") +
    # xlim(0, nrow(data2)) +

}
```

```{r perform-clustering}
#| eval: true

# the critical cluster distance
cluster_dist <- 3400 # m
min_cluster_size <- 16 # cluster member count

locs <- data %>% 
  distinct(x, y)

# basic clustering
locs_clustered <- cluster_locs(
  input = locs,
  max_dist = cluster_dist, # m 
  output_var = "cluster",
  xvar = "x",
  yvar = "y"
) 


# remove cluster column if already present
if ("cluster" %in% colnames(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    select(-cluster)
}

# join the cluster number to the data
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(
    locs_clustered,
    by = join_by(x == x, y == y),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )
  
# plot number of cluster members
locs_clustered  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = max(data$cluster))


tiny_clusters <- data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count < min_cluster_size) %>%
  pull(cluster)

data_clusters <- data %>%  
  filter(!cluster %in% tiny_clusters)  
```

```{r cluster-wise-detrend}
#| eval: true

cluster_detrend <- function(cl) {
  sub_dc <- data_clusters %>%
    filter(cluster == cl)
  sub_dc <- sub_dc %>%
    mutate(
      hwd2_cl = lm(hw ~ x + y, sub_dc)$residual,
      lwd2_cl = lm(lw ~ x + y, sub_dc)$residual
    )
  return(sub_dc)
}

data_clusters <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    unique(data_clusters$cluster),
    FUN = cluster_detrend
  )
)

```


```{r show-map}
#| eval: false

data_clusters %>%
  # filter(region == "KAL") %>% 
  select(x, y, code, hwd2_cl ) %>% 
  summarize(mean(hwd2_cl), .by = c(code, x, y)) %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = 31370
  ) %>% 
  mapview(
    map.types = c("OpenTopoMap"),
    zcol = "mean(hwd2_cl)"
  )

```

# Analyses

## gstat variogram

Try on a subset:
```{r gstat-subset-variogram}
#| eval: true

gstest <- test
sp::coordinates(gstest) = ~x+y
vgrm <- gstat::variogram(
  hwd2 ~ 1,
  data = gstest,
  cutoff = extent,
  width = extent / n_bins
  )
plot(vgrm, color = "darkblue", type = "o")
```
~~Takes longer than a coffee break.~~ works well on xg3 subset.


## sdmTMB

### single cluster tryout

```{r sdmTMB-mesh-test}
#| eval: true
test_mesh <- make_mesh(test, xy_cols = c("x", "y"), cutoff = as.integer(extent / n_bins))
print(test_mesh$mesh$n)
plot(test_mesh)

```


```{r sdmTMB-model-test}
#| eval: true
test_fit <- sdmTMB(
  # hw ~ 1,
  # hwd2 ~ 1,
  hwd2_cl ~ 1,
  # lw ~ 1,
  # lwd2 ~ 1,
  # lwd2_cl ~ 1,
  data = test,
  mesh = test_mesh,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  # time = "hyear",
  # spatiotemporal = "IID",
  spatial = "on"
)
test_fiti <- run_extra_optimization(test_fit)
sanity(test_fiti)
test_fiti
```

::: {.callout-note}
Linear de-trending makes sense!

- It approximately removes spatial covariates.
- This makes use of `spatial_varying` parameters unnecessary.
- Matérn distance reduces accordingly, seems more plausible.

:::

# Variogram

## goal
- a custom-made variogram
- joined per cluster and year
- clusterwise de-trending


## self-join

```{r raw-data-join-dbplyr}
raw_diffdata_export_file <- "data/xg3_couplingdata_clusterwise.parquet"
reload <- force_database_download || !file.exists(raw_diffdata_export_file)

if (reload) {
  diffdata_raw <- data_clusters %>%
    left_join(data_clusters,
      by = join_by(
        idx > idx, # only different locations
        cluster == cluster, # from the same cluster
        hyear == hyear # in the same year
      )
    ) %>% mutate(
      dr = sqrt((x.y-x.x)^2 + (y.y-y.x)^2),
      dlg3 = abs(lw.y - lw.x),
      dlg3_cld = abs(lwd2_cl.y - lwd2_cl.x),
      dhg3 = abs(hw.y - hw.x),
      dhg3_cld = abs(hwd2_cl.y - hwd2_cl.x)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      dr < extent
      ) 

  write_parquet(diffdata_raw, sink = raw_diffdata_export_file)
} else {
  diffdata_raw <- read_parquet(raw_diffdata_export_file)
}

glimpse(diffdata_raw)
diffdata_raw %>% count
```

TODO query filter depth?


```{r raw-data-processing}
diffdata <- diffdata_raw %>%
  rename(
    idx1 = idx.x,
    loc1 = code.x, 
    x1   = x.x,
    y1   = y.x,
    lw1  = lw.x,
    lwd1 = lwd2_cl.x,
    hw1  = hw.x,
    hwd1 = hwd2_cl.x,
    idx2 = idx.y,
    loc2 = code.y, 
    x2   = x.y,
    y2   = y.y,
    lw2  = lw.y,
    lwd2 = lwd2_cl.y,
    hw2  = hw.y,
    hwd2 = hwd2_cl.y
  ) %>% select(
    idx1, loc1, x1, y1, 
    lw1, lwd1, hw1, hwd1,
    idx2, loc2, x2, y2, 
    lw2, lwd2, hw2, hwd2,
    hyear, dr
  ) %>%
  filter_at(
    vars(
      idx1, loc1, x1, y1, 
      lw1, lwd1, hw1, hwd1,
      idx2, loc2, x2, y2, 
      lw2, lwd2, hw2, hwd2,
      hyear, dr
      ),
    all_vars(!is.na(.))
  )

diffdata <- diffdata %>%
  mutate(
    region = substring(loc1, 1, 3),
    dx = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2),
    distance_bin = cut(
      dx,
      breaks = seq(
        -extent/n_bins,
        extent,
        length.out = n_bins+2
      ) # cut to "meters" bin
    ),
    dx_log = log10(dx + 1),
    dlw = lw2-lw1,
    dhw = hw2-hw1,
    dlwd = lwd2 - lwd1, # cluster-wise de-trended difference
    dhwd = hwd2 - hwd1 # cluster-wise de-trended difference
  ) %>% 
  arrange(idx1, idx2) %>% 
  mutate_at(
    vars(
      region, loc1, loc2, distance_bin, hyear
    ), as.factor
  ) 
glimpse(diffdata)
```


## sample size

 
```{r fig-samplesize}
#| label: fig-samplesize
#| fig-cap: "Sample size (number of site pairs observed) per distance (${\\Delta x}$)."
plot_bins <- 128
diffdata %>% 
  mutate(
    distance_bin = cut(
      dx,
      breaks = seq(
        -extent/plot_bins,
        extent,
        length.out = plot_bins+2)
    ), # more coarse binning than above (better vis)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarize(cnt = n()) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(distance_bin) %>% 
  mutate(distance = extent/n_bins * as.numeric(distance_bin)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = distance, y = cnt)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,extent,64)) +
  xlab("distance (m)") +
  ylab("number of observations (N)") +
  theme_bw()
```

## binned data
*There must be a reason why 9 out of 10 variogram experts apply binning.*


```{r bin-data}
nanmean <- function (val) mean(val, na.rm = TRUE)
nanvar <- function (val) var(val, na.rm = TRUE)
# nansem <- function (val) sd(val, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(val)))
diffdata_binned <- diffdata %>%
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarize(
    vlg3 = 0.5 * nanvar(dlw),
    vhg3 = 0.5 * nanvar(dhw),
    vlg3d = 0.5 * nanvar(dlwd),
    vhg3d = 0.5 * nanvar(dhwd),
    dx = nanmean(abs(dx)), 
    dlg3  = nanmean(dlw),
    dhg3  = nanmean(dhw),
    dlg3d = nanmean(dlwd),
    dhg3d = nanmean(dhwd),
    cnt = n()
  ) %>% ungroup %>% arrange(dx)
glimpse(diffdata_binned)
```

```{r plot-data-binned}
#| label: fig-dw-dx-binned
#| fig-cap: "Distance-Difference-Plot of difference in water level (mTAW) against binned distance ($\\Delta x$)."

diffdata_binned %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dx, y = abs(dhg3d))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(color = "black") +
  xlab("site distance (m)") +
  ylab("mean absolute water level difference <|Δw|> (mTAW)") +
  theme_bw() 

```


## self-made variogram
```{r variogram}
#| label: fig-variogram

trafo <- function(x) x
# trafo <- function(x) log(x)

diffdata_binned %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dx, y = trafo(vlg3d))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(color = 'darkblue') +
  xlab("site distance (m), binned") +
  ylab("semivariance in de-trended LG3: var(lg3)/2 (m)") +

diffdata_binned %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dx, y = trafo(vhg3d))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(color = 'darkblue') +
```
